title: Design and ICH validation of a stability-indicating green RP-HPLC method for 5,6,7-trihydroxyflavone with multi-metric greenness evaluation and application to nanopharmaceutical systems
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,19225-19241
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01533F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sweta Acharya, Ankit Jain
Buffer-free, stability-indicating RP-HPLC enables rapid analysis of baicalein. Integrated greenness metrics and nanoformulation applicability establish a simple, sustainable, and versatile analytical platform.
